AMENDMENT OF SOLICITATION/MODIFICATION OF CONTRACT (SF 30)
Amendment 0001 to Solicitation SPE2DM-26-Q-0412
Dated September 30, 2026
The purpose of this amendment is to revise the delivery schedule.
Section 4 Delivery is revised as follows: Delivery shall be made within 20 calendar days after award, FOB Destination.
Quoters must acknowledge receipt of this amendment 0001 by signing block 15 of the SF 30 and returning it with the quote.
All other terms and conditions remain unchanged.
